description: Defines an immutable data class JLGCollectionSheetFlatData for representing flat data related to joint liability group's collection sheet in the Fineract project.

classes.name: JLGCollectionSheetFlatData
classes.description: Immutable data object for extracting flat data for joint liability group's collection sheet.

methods.name: JLGCollectionSheetFlatData
methods.description: Constructor initializing all fields of the data object.

methods.name: getGroupName
methods.description: Returns the name of the group.

methods.name: getGroupId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the group.

methods.name: getStaffId
methods.description: Returns the staff ID associated with the group.

methods.name: getStaffName
methods.description: Returns the name of the staff.

methods.name: getLoanDueData
methods.description: Returns a LoanDueData object with loan-related financial details.

methods.name: getClientData
methods.description: Returns a JLGClientData object with client details and attendance.

methods.name: getJLGGroupData
methods.description: Returns a JLGGroupData object with group details.
